data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts that the critics fail the inspectable-mechanism requirement of the 'mechanist school-0 policy,' but the problem context defines the standard as 'adjudication-ritual flags sustained (§11.3)' and never references a 'mechanist school-0 policy' or an 'inspectable-mechanism requirement.' SRC_001 substitutes an external standard the problem did not ask for, making its justification for sustaining the §11.3 flags unsupported by the stated audit scope.
